purpose: Machine-checkable ground truth for the CCRU Pandemonium/Numogram corpus. Every fact here is stated verbatim or structually entailed by the staged chunk text (data/sources/ccru_pandemonium/chunk_*.txt). Used by scripts/validate_numogram_groundtruth.py to score distill extraction quality.

syzygies.note: five pairs grouping the ten zones

currents.note: each syzygy's arithmetic difference defines a current linking to a tractor zone; currents are the numogram's main flows

gates.note: zone number digitally cumulated defines a gate's value; gates/channels are secondary flows

demon_identity.note: each demon uniquely identified by a zone-net pole pair, e.g. Lurgo 1::0

demon_nature.note: demons are irreducible distances between zone pairs; simultaneously gap, link, hole, entity

phase_groupings.note: demons grouped by phase; each phase opened by a door with domain, planetary affinity, spinal level

necronomicon_link.note: the Matrix of all demons (Pandemonium) is called Necronomicon / Book of Dead Names; retroactively sent from the future into the distant past

rite_invariants.endpoint_pole_rule: For each rite digit string, the unordered pair of its first and last digit must equal the unordered set of the demon's pole pair digits. Verified true for all 8 corpus rites: 1890->{1,0}=1::0; 271890->{2,0}; 27541890->{2,0}; 1872->{1,2}=2::1; 271->{2,1}; 27541->{2,1}; 18723->{1,3}=3::1; 1872563->{1,3}.
rite_invariants.syzygy_edge_density: Fraction of consecutive digit pairs in a rite summing to 9 (zygonovic steps), computed over all 8 corpus rites: 1890: 18,90 sum-9 -> 2/3; 271890: 27,18,90 -> 3/5; 27541890: 27,54,18,90 -> 4/7; 1872: 18,72 -> 2/3; 271: 27 -> 1/2; 27541: 27,54 -> 2/4; 18723: 18,72 -> 2/4; 1872563: 18,72 -> 2/6. Rites alternate syzygy (sum-9) steps with connector steps; the checker recomputes these rather than trusting this note.
rite_invariants.closed_corpus: The concordance page prints exactly 8 rite strings (Rt/Pth 1-8) and states 'For the full list of Rites and Paths, please refer to the original document.' Therefore any rite digit-string extracted by the distiller that is NOT one of these 8 is a fabrication flag.

tier_note: Tier-C modern fiction-theory apparatus. A correct distillation must also preserve the modern/fiction-theory provenance signal (CCRU, Lemurian Time-Sorcery, hyperstition); any output presenting this as a historical grimoire lineage witness is a provenance error.
